status: unreleased source changes; published releases and installed player profiles unchanged

findings.diagonal_junction: The old compaction mask checked four side neighbours but not a diagonally touching coarse tile. The common corner could sink while the unsplit neighbouring edges remained straight, leaving triangular openings. All eight neighbours now constrain displacement.
findings.shifted_sector_edge: A valid authored XY offset can move a shared vertex outside its nominal sector. Sampling sector-local footprint layers then clamps different points on either mesh. Terrain and surface consumers now resolve the installed field layer from the actual world coordinate.
findings.consumers: Ground-contact height, lighting, track normals and biome mound compression use the same world-space lookup as terrain.

reproduction.authored_scope: Three original Ingos maps, nine dry snow points, native footfall dispatch and a controlled native tile-retirement step retaining the neighbouring field. Diagnostic changes affect fragment colour only, not vertex geometry. Synthetic fixtures additionally cover 16 occupancy patterns, interior/four-sector junctions, three XY offsets and four views.
reproduction.hd_package: community.hd-lands-textures@1.5.0, real installed archives, mounted only in disposable test profiles
reproduction.isolated_pixels: Unaliased T-junction rasterization produces isolated background pixels even with deformation disabled. The test records these separately and rejects any connected opening (two or more four-connected background pixels); no MSAA is used.
